view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large warehouse interior with high ceilings and concrete floors. Dominant red metal shelving units fill the background, stocked with boxes and pallets. An orange forklift is partially visible on the right. A person walks in the left distance near blue racks. The scene suggests active inventory management.

objects.label: red metal shelving unit
objects.observation: Tall, multi-tiered red metal shelves occupy the center and left background, filled with cardboard boxes and labeled items. They stand independently on the floor, extending from near the ceiling to ground level. No visible mounting hardware.

objects.label: orange forklift
objects.observation: An orange forklift is positioned on the right side of the frame, partially cropped. Its control panel and part of the mast are visible. It rests on the concrete floor, appearing stationary. No direct support structures are visible.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: A person wearing dark clothing is seen walking in the far-left background near blue racks. Their motion causes slight blur. They appear to be moving away from the camera toward the left edge of the frame.

objects.label: blue metal racks
objects.observation: Blue metal racks are located in the far-left background, behind the person. They appear to be tall and narrow, possibly for storing long items. They stand freestanding on the concrete floor, partially obscured by the person’s movement.

objects.label: stacked red plastic crates
objects.observation: Several red plastic crates are stacked in two piles on wooden pallets near the center-right foreground. They are arranged neatly and sit directly on the concrete floor. No visible supports other than the pallets.

objects.label: wooden pallets
objects.observation: Wooden pallets are scattered throughout the scene, supporting various items. One holds the red crates, another holds cardboard boxes and a blue barrel. They rest directly on the concrete floor without visible supports.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Cardboard boxes are stored on the red shelves and on pallets. Some are stacked, others are loose. They vary in size and shape, mostly brown, with some white labels. They are supported by the shelves or pallets.

objects.label: blue barrel
objects.observation: A blue barrel sits on a wooden pallet near the center-right. It is cylindrical, standing upright, and appears to contain liquid. It rests directly on the pallet, which is on the concrete floor.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s3-36540", "image_size": [1920, 1080], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
